heading_en: Cap on the Risk Weights Applied to Securitization Exposures
summary_ja: 裏付資産の構成を常に把握できる最優先証券化エクスポージャーについて、プール種別ごとに裏付資産の加重平均リスク・ウェイトをリスク・ウェイトの上限とできる。
summary_en: Allows a cap on the risk weight of a senior securitization exposure, set at the weighted-average risk weight of the underlying assets under the pool-type-specific method, where the composition of the underlying assets is always known.
paragraphs: Notwithstanding Division 2 through the preceding Division, where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company holds a senior securitization exposure (excluding re-securitization exposures) and is able to know the composition of its underlying assets at all times, it may, according to the classification of cases set out in the following items, use the value prescribed in each item as the upper limit of the risk weight applied to that senior securitization exposure: (i) where the senior securitization exposure is a securitization exposure relating to an IRB pool: the weighted-average risk weight of the amounts calculated for all exposures of the underlying assets, using as the risk weight the ratio obtained by dividing the sum of the credit risk-weighted assets calculated pursuant to the provisions of the preceding Chapter and the amount obtained by multiplying the expected loss amount by 12.5, by the amount of that senior securitization exposure; (ii) where the senior securitization exposure is a securitization exposure relating to an SA pool: the weighted-average risk weight of the amounts calculated for all exposures of the underlying assets, using the risk weights calculated pursuant to the provisions of Chapter 3; (iii) where the senior securitization exposure is a securitization exposure relating to a mixed pool and the Ultimate Designated Parent Company uses the internal ratings-based approach-compliant method: for those exposures of the underlying assets that satisfy all of the requirements set out in Article 1, item (lxxiii)(a) and (b), the ratio obtained by dividing the sum of the credit risk-weighted assets calculated pursuant to the provisions of the preceding Chapter and the amount obtained by multiplying the expected loss amount by 12.5, by the amount of that senior securitization exposure is used as the risk weight, and for all other exposures, the risk weights calculated pursuant to the provisions of Chapter 3 are used, and the weighted-average risk weight of the amounts calculated for all exposures of the underlying assets is the cap; (iv) where the senior securitization exposure is a securitization exposure relating to a mixed pool and the Ultimate Designated Parent Company uses the external ratings-based approach-compliant method or the standardized approach-compliant method: the weighted-average risk weight of the amounts calculated for all exposures of the underlying assets, using the risk weights calculated pursuant to the provisions of Chapter 3.
